description: The reSpeaker has no speaker, so HA's voice-timer chime is inaudible and only the LED ring shows. HA emits NO event for timer completion (verified against the whole event bus), so this infers it: local playback while the satellite is NOT in a conversation -- conversational turns also play locally (~107 state changes in 20 min), which is why the idle condition is load-bearing. Announces via the resolver say_text (play_media) route because MA announcements fail on this player ('Failed to stream audio'): MA requires correct state/elapsed reporting, which Universal->Squeezelite does not provide. Repeats every 25s while the alarm is still ringing, up to 8 times, stopping when the timer is dismissed. Cannot name WHICH timer finished -- no event payload exists; that needs the firmware on_timer_finished hook. The loop also requires the satellite to be idle: our own announcement can false-wake it (heard as 'The pipeline is finished'), and a conversation makes the satellite's media_player play too -- without this the loop could be sustained by the turns it caused. GUARDED against the wake-sound race: the wake chime makes the satellite's media_player play ~180ms before HA marks it listening, so a plain state condition fires on every wake word. The automation therefore waits 3s and re-checks that the satellite is still idle before announcing.
